title: Simpson's paradox
description: A correlation and a rate that reverse when stratified, in R: bill length against depth in palmerpenguins (Gorman et al. 2014), with a param choosing the stratifying variable, and the 1973 Berkeley admissions in UCBAdmissions with the Mantel-Haenszel odds ratio. The note says why the stratified one is not automatically right. Pearson's r and the odds ratio are checked by hand in the test.

# The real measurements of Gorman et al. 2014, as packaged by palmerpenguins.
main <- function(ctx) {
  p <- palmerpenguins::penguins
  p <- p[complete.cases(p[, c("bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm")]), ]
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "penguins.csv")
  write.csv(p[, c("species", "sex", "island", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm")], file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("penguins", list(value = file))
  counts <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(p$species, p$island))
  counts <- cbind(種 = rownames(counts), counts, 合計 = rowSums(counts))
  message(nrow(p), " penguins with both bill measurements")
  ctx$display_table(counts)
}

# Pearson's r of bill length and bill depth: overall and within each stratum.
main <- function(ctx) {
  by <- ctx$params$stratify
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("penguins"))
  if (!by %in% c("species", "sex", "island")) stop("stratify must be species, sex or island, not ", by)
  d$stratum <- d[[by]]
  d <- d[!is.na(d$stratum), ]  # sex is unknown for some penguins

  line <- function(name, x) {
    test <- cor.test(x$bill_length_mm, x$bill_depth_mm)
    data.frame(stratify = by, stratum = name, n = nrow(x), r = unname(test$estimate),
               lower = test$conf.int[1], upper = test$conf.int[2],
               slope = unname(coef(lm(bill_depth_mm ~ bill_length_mm, x))[2]))
  }
  overall <- line("全体", d)
  strata <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$stratum), function(x) line(x$stratum[1], x)))
  result <- rbind(overall, strata)
  result$reversed <- sign(result$r) != sign(overall$r)

  points <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "points.csv")
  write.csv(d[, c("stratum", "bill_length_mm", "bill_depth_mm")], points, row.names = FALSE)
  correlations <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "correlations.csv")
  write.csv(result, correlations, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("points", list(value = points))
  ctx$output("correlations", list(value = correlations))

  shown <- data.frame(
    層 = result$stratum, n = result$n, r = sprintf("%.3f", result$r),
    `95%CI` = sprintf("%.2f〜%.2f", result$lower, result$upper),
    傾き = sprintf("%.3f", result$slope),
    向き = ifelse(result$stratum == "全体", "", ifelse(result$reversed, "全体と逆", "全体と同じ")),
    check.names = FALSE)
  ctx$display_table(shown)
}

library(ggplot2)

# The same points with the overall line and one line per stratum.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("points"))
  r <- read.csv(ctx$path("correlations"))
  strata <- r[r$stratum != "全体", ]
  labels <- setNames(sprintf("%s (r = %.2f)", strata$stratum, strata$r), strata$stratum)
  figure <- ggplot(d, aes(bill_length_mm, bill_depth_mm)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = stratum), alpha = 0.55, size = 1.4) +
    geom_smooth(aes(colour = stratum), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, se = FALSE, colour = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#D55E00", "#0072B2", "#009E73")[seq_len(nrow(strata))], labels = labels, name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "くちばしの長さ (mm)", y = "くちばしの厚さ (mm)",
         title = sprintf("%s で層別: 全体 (破線) r = %.2f", r$stratify[1], r$r[r$stratum == "全体"])) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = "Bill length against bill depth, overall and by stratum", width = 7.5, height = 5.2)
}

cards.summary: 3 つの層別を並べて比べる
details: 3 つの層別を並べて比べる

files.text:
library(ggplot2)

# r per stratum for all three stratifying variables, side by side.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("penguins"))
  overall <- cor(d$bill_length_mm, d$bill_depth_mm)
  rows <- lapply(c("species", "sex", "island"), function(by) {
    x <- d[!is.na(d[[by]]), ]
    do.call(rbind, lapply(split(x, x[[by]]), function(s) {
      test <- cor.test(s$bill_length_mm, s$bill_depth_mm)
      data.frame(by = by, stratum = s[[by]][1], n = nrow(s), r = unname(test$estimate),
                 lower = test$conf.int[1], upper = test$conf.int[2])
    }))
  })
  rows <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  rows$by <- factor(rows$by, levels = c("species", "sex", "island"))
  rows$side <- ifelse(sign(rows$r) != sign(overall), "全体と逆向き", "全体と同じ向き")
  rows$label <- sprintf("%s (n=%d)", rows$stratum, rows$n)
  verdict <- tapply(rows$side == "全体と逆向き", rows$by, sum)
  message("strata reversed: ", paste(names(verdict), verdict, collapse = ", "))
  figure <- ggplot(rows, aes(r, reorder(label, r), colour = side)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = overall, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), width = 0, orientation = "y", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) +
    facet_grid(by ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("全体と逆向き" = "#D55E00", "全体と同じ向き" = "#0072B2"), name = NULL) +
    labs(x = "Pearson の r (横線は 95% 信頼区間)", y = NULL,
         title = sprintf("層別の変数で逆転は変わる: 破線が全体 r = %.2f", overall)) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = "Correlation in each stratum for species, sex and island", width = 7.5, height = 5.2)
}

cards.summary: Berkeley の出願を学科ごとに集計する
details: Berkeley の出願を学科ごとに集計する

outputs.name: admissions
outputs.note: 合否・性別・学科ごとの人数の CSV

files.text:
# UCBAdmissions from base R's datasets: Berkeley, autumn 1973.
main <- function(ctx) {
  t <- datasets::UCBAdmissions
  rows <- as.data.frame(t, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  names(rows) <- c("admit", "gender", "dept", "count")
  file <- file.path(ctx$output_directory, "admissions.csv")
  write.csv(rows, file, row.names = FALSE)
  ctx$output("admissions", list(value = file))

  or <- function(m) m["Admitted", "Male"] * m["Rejected", "Female"] / (m["Rejected", "Male"] * m["Admitted", "Female"])
  line <- function(name, m) data.frame(
    学科 = name,
    男性応募 = sum(m[, "Male"]), 男性合格率 = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * m["Admitted", "Male"] / sum(m[, "Male"])),
    女性応募 = sum(m[, "Female"]), 女性合格率 = sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * m["Admitted", "Female"] / sum(m[, "Female"])),
    オッズ比 = sprintf("%.2f", or(m)))
  by_dept <- do.call(rbind, lapply(dimnames(t)$Dept, function(k) line(k, t[, , k])))
  all <- line("全体 (集計)", margin.table(t, c(1, 2)))
  mh <- mantelhaen.test(t, correct = FALSE)
  common <- data.frame(学科 = "学科で調整 (Mantel–Haenszel)", 男性応募 = "", 男性合格率 = "", 女性応募 = "", 女性合格率 = "",
                       オッズ比 = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f〜%.2f)", mh$estimate, mh$conf.int[1], mh$conf.int[2]))
  message(sprintf("Mantel-Haenszel common odds ratio %.4f, X2 %.3f, p %.3f", mh$estimate, mh$statistic, mh$p.value))
  ctx$display_table(rbind(by_dept, all, common))
}

files.text:
library(ggplot2)

# Why the totals differ: rates by department, drawn by where people applied.
main <- function(ctx) {
  d <- read.csv(ctx$path("admissions"))
  wide <- aggregate(count ~ gender + dept, d, sum)
  names(wide)[3] <- "applied"
  admitted <- d[d$admit == "Admitted", c("gender", "dept", "count")]
  wide <- merge(wide, admitted)
  wide$rate <- 100 * wide$count / wide$applied
  overall <- aggregate(cbind(count, applied) ~ gender, wide, sum)
  overall$rate <- 100 * overall$count / overall$applied
  wide$gender <- factor(wide$gender, c("Male", "Female"), c("男性", "女性"))
  overall$gender <- factor(overall$gender, c("Male", "Female"), c("男性", "女性"))
  colours <- c("男性" = "#0072B2", "女性" = "#D55E00")
  figure <- ggplot(wide, aes(dept, rate, colour = gender)) +
    geom_hline(data = overall, aes(yintercept = rate, colour = gender), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_text(data = overall, aes(x = 6.45, y = rate, label = sprintf("全体 %s %.1f%%", gender, rate)),
              hjust = 1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(size = applied), alpha = 0.75, position = position_dodge(width = 0.35)) +
    scale_x_discrete() +
    scale_colour_manual(values = colours, name = NULL) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 13, name = "応募者数") +
    labs(x = "学科 (匿名化された A〜F)", y = "合格率 (%)", title = "女性の応募は合格率の低い学科に偏っていた") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(legend.position = "top")
  ctx$plot(print(figure), alt = "Admission rate by department and gender, with the number of applicants", width = 7.5, height = 5.2)
}

notes.html:
集計と層別で逆転する関係

相関や比率は、データをまとめて見るか層に分けて見るかで符号まで変わることがあります（Simpson のパラドックス）。全体の相関は、層内の相関と層間の差の足し合わせです。

Cov⁡(X,Y)=E[Cov⁡(X,Y∣Z)]⏟層内+Cov⁡(E[X∣Z], E[Y∣Z])⏟層間\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y) = \underbrace{\mathrm{E}[\operatorname{Cov}(X,Y \mid Z)]}_{\text{層内}} + \underbrace{\operatorname{Cov}(\mathrm{E}[X \mid Z],\, \mathrm{E}[Y \mid Z])}_{\text{層間}}

上の枝 Palmer Penguins（Gorman, Williams & Fraser 2014、南極 Palmer 基地の実測。palmerpenguins パッケージ）。くちばしの長さと厚さの相関です。correlate の stratify を species / sex / island に変えて、その先を実行し直せます。survey は 3 つを並べて見せます。種では全層で逆転し、性別では逆転せず、島では Biscoe（アデリーとジェンツーが混ざる）だけ負のまま残ります。

下の枝 1973 年 Berkeley 大学院の出願（Bickel, Hammel & O'Connell 1975、R の UCBAdmissions）。全体では男性が通りやすく、学科で調整すると差はほぼ消えます。

層別したほうが常に正しいわけではありません。 どちらを読むかは因果の問いで決まります。応募先の選択が性別の結果として生じるなら（媒介）、「性別の総合的な影響」を問うときに応募先で調整してはいけません。学科ごとの審査で差別があったかを問うなら、層別が答えに近づきます。ただしそれにも、学科内の応募者の違いという未測定の交絡が残ります。データだけではこの区別はつかず、値を読む前に問いを決める必要があります。
